description:
My Wine turns ChatGPT into a wine-shopping assistant backed by World Wine List's live price-monitoring platform: 700k+ wines across 100k+ online merchants. Tell it what you want, a grape, a region, a style, a food pairing, a budget or a specific bottle and vintage, and it returns real retail offers available in your own country: merchant, price in your currency and a direct link to buy.

How it works: the plugin reads your marketplace region from your My Wine profile, optionally resolves a retailer you named (for example Waitrose, Majestic or Systembolaget), then searches live offers by keywords, price range and vintage. A built-in sommelier prompt guides a short conversation before searching.

The plugin is read-only: it never places orders and never changes your account. Purchases happen on the merchant's own website. Requires a free My Wine account (mywine.dev).

defaultPrompt: Find me a dry Riesling under 20 for tonight
I'm cooking steak. Recommend a bold red between 25 and 50
Does Waitrose have any Argentinian Malbec right now?
